a: Go is a statically typed language by Google, known for simplicity and strong concurrency.
A goroutine is a lightweight concurrent function managed by the Go runtime.
Channels communicate between goroutines: ch := make(chan int)
Interfaces in Go are satisfied implicitly by implementing methods.
Functions often return (value, error); check errors explicitly.
Go modules (go.mod) manage dependencies and versions.
defer schedules a call to run when the surrounding function returns.
Structs group fields; methods can have value or pointer receivers.
context.Context carries deadlines, cancelation, and request-scoped values.
net/http provides a production-ready HTTP server in the standard library.
